title: All The Pretty Horses
author: Cormac McCarthy
summary: In 1949, sixteen-year-old John Grady Cole leaves his Texas ranch with a friend and rides into Mexico, hoping to work with horses. He falls in love, and the trip turns violent and costly.
readIf: you like spare, lyrical westerns with beautiful landscapes and moral weight.
skipIf: you dislike unmarked dialogue or want an upbeat story, since the mood is harsh.
